user.title: Set up Tuya Irrigation
user.description: Click Submit to enable the Tuya Irrigation integration. It registers the `irrigation_by_seconds` and `irrigation_by_liters` services and auto-registers the Lovelace card bundle. There is nothing to configure here.

abort.already_configured: Tuya Irrigation is already set up.

irrigation_by_seconds.name: Seconds⏰💧 (🌱timed irrigation)
irrigation_by_seconds.description: Opens the valve for N seconds, then closes it. The timer runs in Home Assistant, so it works with the browser closed and even if the valve's own timer is unreliable.

switch_entity.name: Valve
switch_entity.description: The switch entity that controls the irrigation valve.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to keep the valve open.

irrigation_by_liters.name: Liters🪣💧 (🌱volume irrigation)
irrigation_by_liters.description: Opens the valve and closes it once the requested volume has been delivered. If no water flows, the valve is closed anyway after a few minutes.

switch_entity.name: Valve
switch_entity.description: The switch entity that controls the irrigation valve.

timeout_seconds.name: Max run time [default 1 h]
timeout_seconds.description: Forced close after this time, even if the volume was not reached.

zha_layer_missing.title: Tuya ZHA integration missing
zha_layer_missing.description:
A ZHA irrigation valve was detected, but the **Tuya ZHA** integration (`zha_tuya_quirks`) is not installed or not loaded. It provides the GiEX QT06 quirk (correct clock epoch, clock sync before every valve open, local-time start/end stamps) and the keep-alive for weak-signal battery valves. Irrigation still works without it, but the valve's start/end times will drift and a battery valve on a weak link may go unavailable.

Install it from HACS (custom repository `SimoneAvogadro/zha-tuya-quirks`, category Integration), add it under Settings → Devices & Services, then restart Home Assistant. This issue clears itself once the integration is loaded.
